task.title: Phase N4.5 Recorded Baseline Calibration: Recorder-originated visual references against N3.2
task.objective: Implement N4.5 awkit-vra.13.5: the informational benchmark:recorder-visual-baseline records headed visual references through the real RecorderService.captureVisualReference on the unchanged fusion lab, persists them through persistRecordedVisualReferences, and replays them headed and headless at DPR 1, 1.25 and 2 with fresh launches using the unchanged N3.2 method and decideVisualAgreement in shadow, reporting capture cost against the unchanged 1500 ms ceiling, recall, identical, agreed, false identical and false agreed per mode, DPR and scenario, side by side with N3.2. N4.5 passes only if Recorder-originated baselines add no false agreed outcomes relative to N3.2. No runner, locator, threshold, IPC, UI or persistence change; N4.6 not implemented.
